title: Units of measure
binding: a questionnaire question's `unit`, read from styling_metadata.phc.unit
source: Every unit symbol the shipped questionnaires declare, at bundles/*/ and questionnaires/*.json. A declared unit is a bound unit whether or not any mapping projects it today, which is what stops 'mmol per litre' reaching a column FHIR says is UCUM. UCUM is a small grammar rather than a code list, so a cache of the symbols in use is the honest shape until a real validator is behind the seam; see the ceiling in kernel/terminology.py.
